# Woodland herb blend

Type: Material | Internal ID: SpiceForests | Source: The Bog Witch | Usage: Crafting | Buy: 120, Coins, for 5 | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Woodland herb blend can be purchased from The Bog Witch at 120 Coins for 5 items. It is only sold after The Elder has been defeated.

### Crafting
